snippet.title: Wilderdark - Steam Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
Something dangerous is lurking in the wilderness. Wilderdark is a first-person survival horror game where you must navigate a strange island inhabited by ectoparasitic dinosaurs and organisms. You must remain vigilant to stealthily obtain evidence, samples, and craft tools to survive.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2735850/Wilderdark/
